  WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Refund'
    AND ft.transaction_date >= cc.date_valid_from
    AND ft.transaction_date <= cc.date_valid_to
),

         AVG(transaction_amount) AS avg_refund
  FROM valid_refunds
  GROUP BY ym
)

        yr_mon,
        AVG(transaction_amount) AS avg_refund
